# Pixel Virtual Pet

A cute pixel-style virtual pet built with plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. No external dependencies or network requests — fully offline.

## Features

- CSS-drawn pixel pet with a friendly face
- Three stats: Hunger, Happiness, and Energy (0–100)
- Feed, Play, and Sleep buttons that adjust stats
- Mood text that updates based on stat thresholds
- Stats slowly decay over time (every 5 seconds)
- Keyboard-accessible labeled buttons with visible focus states
- Responsive layout that works from 360px wide
- Cohesive dark palette with accent colors

## Usage

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. Use the buttons or press Tab + Enter/Space to interact.

## Files

- `index.html` — structure
- `style.css` — styling and pixel pet drawing
- `script.js` — game logic
- `README.md` — this file

## Notes

Stats are clamped between 0 and 100. Decay runs every 5 seconds. No save/load — refresh resets the pet.
